li.label: cloth for mending
li.description: There's cloth in the stores for the winter's mending. Nobody will go about in rags while I can sew.

li.label: steel put by
li.description: There's a proper pile of steel in the stores. I can finish what I start now.

li.label: spare parts on hand
li.description: There are spare parts in the stores. When something breaks down, I can fix it the same day.

li.label: milk for the little one
li.description: There's milk in the stores for the baby. I don't have to count the jugs any more.

li.label: shelves in the stores
li.description: The colony's things are off the floor and on shelves. I can find what I need on the first try.

li.label: the trees by the walls felled
li.description: The trees that leaned over our walls are down. I'll sleep through the next storm.

li.label: a clear way out of the door
li.description: The snow by the doors has been cleared. I can walk out in the morning without filling my boots.

li.label: the roof checked
li.description: I knocked on the rock over my head before I started digging. It sounded sound. I can work now.

li.label: dry boots
li.description: My boots are steaming by the fire. Dry feet, after those weeks of wet ones, are worth everything.

li.label: the first fire's ember
li.description: Every fire here is lit from the one we lit on the first night. Sitting by it, I remember how few of us there were.

li.label: the ones left behind
li.description: Late at night I think about the people at the other colony, and wonder how they're getting on.

li.label: a road song
li.description: I've a song in my head from the strangers' fire. It goes well with the open sky.

li.label: out after dark
li.description: It's dark and I'm still outside. That's when the sandflies came, last time.
